business_description: Visa Inc. is a global digital payments technology company that operates one of the largest card and account-to-account payment networks. The company connects consumers, merchants, financial institutions, fintechs, businesses, and governments, enabling authorization, clearing, and settlement of electronic payments. Visa generally does not issue cards, extend consumer credit, or set cardholder interest rates; its economics are primarily tied to payment volumes, transactions processed, and cross-border activity rather than credit spread income.
business_model: Visa is an asset-light payment network and technology platform. It earns fees from financial institutions, merchants, processors, fintech partners, and other clients for enabling payment acceptance, processing transactions, providing cross-border transaction services, licensing the Visa brand/network, and selling value-added services such as fraud prevention, risk tools, data analytics, tokenization, consulting, and issuer/acquirer processing capabilities. The model benefits from network effects, high incremental margins, global acceptance, and secular cash-to-card/digital-payment conversion.
